title: A quasi-compact separated scheme with finite discrete space is affine
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] whose structure morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If the underlying topological space $|Y|$ is finite and discrete, then $Y$ is affine [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Properties Lemma 0CKV (properties-lemma-dimension-zero), final assertion: a quasi-compact separated zero-dimensional scheme is affine

proof.text: The hypotheses give a scheme with finite discrete underlying space. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-affine], whose statement asserts that every scheme with finite discrete underlying space is affine, proves that $Y$ is affine.
